title: Relief parallax
description: Ivory crosses rise above deep blue recesses and occlude each other as the view shifts.
useCase: Add perceived carved depth through view-dependent height traversal.
reducedMotion: The elapsed-time clock stops. Parameter controls immediately update the static composition.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS swatch appears if unavailable or after context loss. 42-step screen-space height traversal; no mesh geometry or arbitrary DOM refraction.
look: Grid of pale ivory plus-shaped crosses raised over a deep navy ground, with soft grey shaded sides falling toward the lower right.
motion: The viewpoint drifts vertically on a slow 42 s sine and a view-angle slider swings it sideways, so the raised crosses shift over and occlude the recesses.
adapt: The relief is the `FRAGMENT` shader: `heightAt` builds the cross heightfield, a 42-step loop marches it along `view`, and `u_control` sets horizontal tilt. Tune the `.23` depth scale; swap `heightAt` and the `col` colours for your own pattern.
